title: Healthspan
description: WHOOP's Healthspan screen for any source: nine indicators of sleep, strain and fitness on WHOOP's scales and colours, their age impacts and an estimated WHOOP Age. Below, collapsed, the other long-run markers from every source. Each age impact is a straight line through WHOOP's guideline for its indicator, with a slope fitted on screenshots of the app; WHOOP's own slopes depend on age and sex, so read the years as an estimate.

SELECT 100 - moving_average(mean("bodyFat"), 182) FROM "BodyComposition" WHERE 'garmin' = '${weight_from}' AND time >= ${__from}ms - 364d AND time <= ${__to}ms GROUP BY time(1d) fill(previous) tz('$tz')

SELECT 100 - moving_average(mean("body_fat_pct"), 30) FROM "body_composition" WHERE "source" = '${weight_from}' AND "user" = '$user' AND time >= ${__from}ms - 60d AND time <= ${__to}ms GROUP BY time(1d) fill(previous) tz('$tz')

SELECT 100 - moving_average(mean("bodyFat"), 30) FROM "BodyComposition" WHERE 'garmin' = '${weight_from}' AND time >= ${__from}ms - 60d AND time <= ${__to}ms GROUP BY time(1d) fill(previous) tz('$tz')

panels.title: HRV
panels.description: Median overnight HRV (RMSSD) of the nights in the range, from the source picked in HRV from. Devices measure it differently: compare a source with itself.

targets.query: SELECT median("avgOvernightHrv") FROM "SleepSummary" WHERE "sleepTimeSeconds" > 0 AND "remSleepSeconds" > 0 AND 'garmin' = '${hrv_from}' AND $timeFilter
SELECT median("hrv_rmssd_ms") FROM "sleep_session" WHERE "source" = '${hrv_from}' AND "user" = '$user' AND $timeFilter GROUP BY "source"
SELECT median("dailyRmssd") FROM "HRV" WHERE 'fitbit' = '${hrv_from}' AND $timeFilter

panels.title: Sleep spread
panels.description: Standard deviation of the time asleep from one night to the next, from the source picked in Sleep from: the lower, the more regular. Bedtimes are on the Sleep dashboard.

targets.query: SELECT stddev("sleepTimeSeconds") / 60 FROM "SleepSummary" WHERE "sleepTimeSeconds" > 0 AND "remSleepSeconds" > 0 AND 'garmin' = '${sleep_from}' AND $timeFilter
SELECT stddev("asleep_s") / 60 FROM "sleep_session" WHERE "source" = '${sleep_from}' AND "user" = '$user' AND "kind" != 'nap' AND $timeFilter GROUP BY "source"
SELECT stddev("minutesAsleep") / 60 FROM "Sleep Summary" WHERE "isMainSleep" =~ /^(True|true)$/ AND 'fitbit' = '${sleep_from}' AND $timeFilter

panels.title: Intensity / week
panels.description: Moderate minutes plus twice the vigorous ones, per week, averaged over the days the watch recorded. The WHO guideline is 150 or more.

targets.query: SELECT (sum("moderateIntensityMinutes") + 2 * sum("vigorousIntensityMinutes")) * 7 / count("totalSteps") FROM "DailyStats" WHERE $timeFilter

panels.title: Training / week
panels.description: Hours of workouts per week over the range, from the source picked in Workouts from (a workout the watch also sent to a diary is in both: pick one).

targets.query: SELECT sum("elapsedDuration") / 3600 / ((${__to} - ${__from}) / 604800000) FROM "ActivitySummary" WHERE 'garmin' = '${workouts_from}' AND $timeFilter

SELECT sum("duration_s") / 3600 / ((${__to} - ${__from}) / 604800000) FROM "exercise" WHERE "source" = '${workouts_from}' AND "user" = '$user' AND "category" != 'adjustment' AND $timeFilter GROUP BY "source"

panels.title: Weight
panels.description: The latest weigh-in in the range, from the source picked in Weight from.

targets.query: SELECT last("weight") / 1000 FROM "BodyComposition" WHERE 'garmin' = '${weight_from}' AND $timeFilter
SELECT last("weight_kg") FROM "body_composition" WHERE "source" = '${weight_from}' AND "user" = '$user' AND $timeFilter GROUP BY "source"

panels.title: Weight change
panels.description: The last weigh-in of the range minus the first, from the source picked in Weight from.

targets.query: SELECT (last("weight") - first("weight")) / 1000 FROM "BodyComposition" WHERE 'garmin' = '${weight_from}' AND $timeFilter
SELECT last("weight_kg") - first("weight_kg") FROM "body_composition" WHERE "source" = '${weight_from}' AND "user" = '$user' AND $timeFilter GROUP BY "source"

panels.title: Body fat
panels.description: The latest body fat reading in the range, from the source picked in Weight from (a source that records weight alone has none).

targets.query: SELECT last("bodyFat") FROM "BodyComposition" WHERE 'garmin' = '${weight_from}' AND $timeFilter
SELECT last("body_fat_pct") FROM "body_composition" WHERE "source" = '${weight_from}' AND "user" = '$user' AND $timeFilter GROUP BY "source"

panels.title: Doses taken
panels.description: Share of the scheduled doses logged as taken, every medication app together (a dose has one).

targets.query: SELECT mean("taken") FROM "medication" WHERE "user" = '$user' AND $timeFilter

panels.title: Resting heart rate
panels.description: Each night's resting heart rate (points) and its 7-night average (line), one colour per source.

targets.query: SELECT mean("restingHeartRate") FROM "SleepSummary" WHERE "sleepTimeSeconds" > 0 AND "remSleepSeconds" > 0 AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time(1d, -12h) fill(none) tz('$tz')

SELECT moving_average(mean("restingHeartRate"), 7) FROM "SleepSummary" WHERE "sleepTimeSeconds" > 0 AND "remSleepSeconds" > 0 AND time >= ${__from}ms - 7d AND time <= ${__to}ms GROUP BY time(1d, -12h) fill(none) tz('$tz')
SELECT mean("resting_hr") FROM "sleep_session" WHERE "user" = '$user' AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time(1d, -12h), "source" fill(none) tz('$tz')
SELECT moving_average(mean("resting_hr"), 7) FROM "sleep_session" WHERE "user" = '$user' AND time >= ${__from}ms - 7d AND time <= ${__to}ms GROUP BY time(1d, -12h), "source" fill(none) tz('$tz')
SELECT mean("value") FROM "RestingHR" WHERE $timeFilter GROUP BY time(1d, -12h) fill(none) tz('$tz')
SELECT moving_average(mean("value"), 7) FROM "RestingHR" WHERE time >= ${__from}ms - 7d AND time <= ${__to}ms GROUP BY time(1d, -12h) fill(none) tz('$tz')

panels.title: Heart rate variability
panels.description: Each night's HRV (points) and its 7-night average (line), one colour per source. Devices measure it differently: read each line against itself.

targets.query: SELECT mean("avgOvernightHrv") FROM "SleepSummary" WHERE "sleepTimeSeconds" > 0 AND "remSleepSeconds" > 0 AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time(1d, -12h) fill(none) tz('$tz')

SELECT moving_average(mean("avgOvernightHrv"), 7) FROM "SleepSummary" WHERE "sleepTimeSeconds" > 0 AND "remSleepSeconds" > 0 AND time >= ${__from}ms - 7d AND time <= ${__to}ms GROUP BY time(1d, -12h) fill(none) tz('$tz')
SELECT mean("hrv_rmssd_ms") FROM "sleep_session" WHERE "user" = '$user' AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time(1d, -12h), "source" fill(none) tz('$tz')
SELECT moving_average(mean("hrv_rmssd_ms"), 7) FROM "sleep_session" WHERE "user" = '$user' AND time >= ${__from}ms - 7d AND time <= ${__to}ms GROUP BY time(1d, -12h), "source" fill(none) tz('$tz')
SELECT mean("dailyRmssd") FROM "HRV" WHERE $timeFilter GROUP BY time(1d, -12h) fill(none) tz('$tz')
SELECT moving_average(mean("dailyRmssd"), 7) FROM "HRV" WHERE time >= ${__from}ms - 7d AND time <= ${__to}ms GROUP BY time(1d, -12h) fill(none) tz('$tz')

panels.title: Time asleep per night
panels.description: Time asleep each night (points) and its 7-night average (line), naps left out; the dashed line is 7 hours.

targets.query: SELECT sum("sleepTimeSeconds") / 3600 FROM "SleepSummary" WHERE "sleepTimeSeconds" > 0 AND "remSleepSeconds" > 0 AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time(1d, -12h) fill(none) tz('$tz')

SELECT moving_average(sum("sleepTimeSeconds"), 7) / 3600 FROM "SleepSummary" WHERE "sleepTimeSeconds" > 0 AND "remSleepSeconds" > 0 AND time >= ${__from}ms - 7d AND time <= ${__to}ms GROUP BY time(1d, -12h) fill(none) tz('$tz')
SELECT sum("asleep_s") / 3600 FROM "sleep_session" WHERE "user" = '$user' AND "kind" != 'nap' AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time(1d, -12h), "source" fill(none) tz('$tz')

SELECT moving_average(sum("asleep_s"), 7) / 3600 FROM "sleep_session" WHERE "user" = '$user' AND "kind" != 'nap' AND time >= ${__from}ms - 7d AND time <= ${__to}ms GROUP BY time(1d, -12h), "source" fill(none) tz('$tz')
SELECT sum("minutesAsleep") / 60 FROM "Sleep Summary" WHERE "isMainSleep" =~ /^(True|true)$/ AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time(1d, -12h) fill(none) tz('$tz')

SELECT moving_average(sum("minutesAsleep"), 7) / 60 FROM "Sleep Summary" WHERE "isMainSleep" =~ /^(True|true)$/ AND time >= ${__from}ms - 7d AND time <= ${__to}ms GROUP BY time(1d, -12h) fill(none) tz('$tz')

panels.title: VO₂ max

SELECT last("VO2_max_value_cycling") FROM "VO2_Max" WHERE $timeFilter GROUP BY time(1d) fill(none) tz('$tz')

panels.title: Intensity minutes per week

targets.query: SELECT sum("m") FROM (SELECT max("moderateIntensityMinutes") + 2 * max("vigorousIntensityMinutes") AS "m" FROM "DailyStats" WHERE $timeFilter GROUP BY time(1d) fill(none) tz('$tz')) WHERE $timeFilter GROUP BY time(1w, -3d) fill(0) tz('$tz')

panels.title: Workout time per week
panels.description: Hours of workouts per week, one line per source: a workout the watch also sent to the food diary is in both lines.

targets.query: SELECT sum("elapsedDuration") / 3600 FROM "ActivitySummary" WHERE $timeFilter GROUP BY time(1w, -3d) fill(0) tz('$tz')
SELECT sum("duration_s") / 3600 FROM "exercise" WHERE "category" != 'adjustment' AND "user" = '$user' AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time(1w, -3d), "source" fill(0) tz('$tz')

SELECT "weight_kg" FROM "body_composition" WHERE "user" = '$user' AND $timeFilter GROUP BY "source"

panels.title: Body fat

targets.query: SELECT "bodyFat" FROM "BodyComposition" WHERE $timeFilter
SELECT "body_fat_pct" FROM "body_composition" WHERE "user" = '$user' AND $timeFilter GROUP BY "source"

panels.title: Steps per day
panels.description: Steps each day (points) and their 7-day average (line), one colour per source; the dashed line is 8,000.

SELECT moving_average(max("totalSteps"), 7) FROM "DailyStats" WHERE time >= ${__from}ms - 7d AND time <= ${__to}ms GROUP BY time(1d) fill(none) tz('$tz')

SELECT moving_average("steps", 7) FROM "daily_activity" WHERE "user" = '$user' AND time >= ${__from}ms - 7d AND time <= ${__to}ms GROUP BY "source"

SELECT moving_average(max("value"), 7) FROM "Total Steps" WHERE time >= ${__from}ms - 7d AND time <= ${__to}ms GROUP BY time(1d) fill(none) tz('$tz')
